[metadata] {"type": "create", "filePath": "/app/retrieve_embedding.py", "content": "import numpy as np
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

def main():
    query = "terminal-bench"
    model_name = "BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5"
    revision = "7999e1d3359715c523056ef9478215996d62a620"
    data_path = "/app/data.txt"
    result_path = "/app/result.txt"

    # Load the model with specific revision
    print(f"Loading model {model_name} at revision {revision}...")
    model = SentenceTransformer(model_name, revision=revision)

    # Read documents from data.txt
    print("Reading documents from data.txt...")
    with open(data_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        documents = [line.strip() for line in f if line.strip()]

    print(f"Total documents: {len(documents)}")

    # Generate embeddings for query
    print("Generating query embedding...")
    query_embedding = model.encode(query, normalize_embeddings=True)

    # Generate embeddings for all documents
    print("Generating document embeddings...")
    doc_embeddings = model.encode(documents, normalize_embeddings=True)

    # Calculate cosine similarities
    print("Calculating cosine similarities...")
    similarities = cosine_similarity([query_embedding], doc_embeddings)[0]

    # Get indices sorted by similarity (descending)
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(similarities)[::-1]

    # Print top 10 results for verification
    print("\nTop 10 most similar documents:")
    for i, idx in enumerate(sorted_indices[:10], 1):
        print(f"{i}. [{similarities[idx]:.4f}] {documents[idx][:80]}...")

    # Get the 5th highest (index 4 in 0-based indexing)
    fifth_highest_idx = sorted_indices[4]
    fifth_highest_doc = documents[fifth_highest_idx]
    fifth_highest_sim = similarities[fifth_highest_idx]

    print(f"\n5th highest similarity document:")
    print(f"Similarity: {fifth_highest_sim:.4f}")
    print(f"Document: {fifth_highest_doc}")

    # Write result to file
    with open(result_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(fifth_highest_doc)

    print(f"\nResult written to {result_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
